neighbours.label: ' by' in its non-agent uses and the word it governs: 'by whom', 'by the standards of', 'hanging by a thread', 'by any …', byline 'By:'; passive-agent 'written by a teacher' is weak
fire: The rules were changed last year, though by whom nobody will say.
The speech was dull even by the standards of a budget debate.
After the third loss, his job was hanging by a thread.
The plan was a failure by any fair measure.
The money was moved abroad, and by whom remains a mystery.
The winter was mild even by the standards of the south coast.
The peace talks were hanging by a thread all through the summer.
The harvest was poor by any reasonable count.
quiet: The rules were changed last year, though nobody will say why.
The speech was dull, like most speeches in a budget debate.
After the third loss, his job was in real danger.
The plan was a failure in every fair sense.
The money was moved abroad with the help of a lawyer.
The winter was mild along most of the south coast.
The peace talks were close to collapse all through the summer.
The harvest was poor in almost every field.

short: non-agent ' by' (by whom, by a thread)
notes: Card: ':' ' par' ' any' ' a' ' by' ' whom'; the + pole is ' with'/' from'. Probes: 'hanging by a thread' 0.59, 'by whom' 0.46, 'even by the standards' 0.44, 'by:' 0.24, 'written by a young teacher' 0.03, 'by means of' 0.09.
